run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate bulk slab objects and write vasp input files for multiple placements
precompute_slabs: precompute slab surfaces for a given bulk index and save them to the precomputed slabs directory
write_surface: write vasp input files and metadata pickle for a specified slab surface to the output directory
run_placements: run adsorbate placement generation for a given adsorbate bulk and surface index combination using multiprocessing
parse_args: parse command line arguments for bulk database adsorbate database output directory and placement generation options
